dedupe_keys.name: commercial ev fleet and battery storage dataset simulation data for vehicle to business applications

description: Michelle Antretter and collaborators publish simulated commercial-fleet charging and stationary-storage results. Zenodo provides separate health/social-service, manufacturing and office archives free under CC BY 4.0. Fifteen-minute tables report vehicle charging power, state of charge, connection status, prices, facility load and photovoltaic production. Scenarios vary charging control, fleets of one, five or ten vehicles, and stationary-storage size. Additional tables summarise annual costs, peaks, investment and payback measures. These data can benchmark vehicle-to-business scheduling and capacity-planning simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this scenario package. Coverage is modelled commercial use cases, with exact location and calendar year unspecified. Assumed prices, duty cycles and investment parameters constrain transfer to another business, and financial results are scenario outputs. No archives were downloaded or economic and electrical balances recomputed. The site tag describes the collection scale; its location is unknown.
